title.value: MOT: a Multi-Omics Transformer for multiclass classification tumour types predictions
title.justification: The paper discusses the development and evaluation of a Multi-Omics Transformer (MOT) model for predicting tumor types using multi-omics data.
title.quote:
DRA

We proposed MOT (Multi-Omic Transformer), a deep learning
based model using the transformer architecture, that discrim-
inates complex phenotypes (herein cancer types) based on five
omics data types: transcriptomics (mRNA and miRNA), epige-
nomics (DNA methylation), copy number variations (CNVs),
and proteomics.

extractions.description: This paper introduces the Multi-Omics Transformer (MOT) model, leveraging transformer architecture for tumor classification based on multi-omics data. The model integrates various omics data (mRNA, miRNA, DNA methylation, CNVs, and proteomics) to discriminate among multiple cancer types, achieving high accuracy even when some data views are missing.
